verdict.rationale: Kong AI Gateway's provider-agnostic API and AI Model Provider abstraction (docs-1, docs-29, docs-30) let developers call different LLM providers through a consistent request/response schema, and its AI MCP Proxy/AI MCP Server entities (docs-13, docs-19, docs-45) standardize tool/function invocation across providers. However, the evidence never explicitly documents a unified function-calling/tool-call schema (e.g., mapping OpenAI-style function calls to Anthropic/Bedrock equivalents) with concrete request examples. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of cross-provider function/tool-call schema normalization, hands-on example showing identical tool-call payloads working against multiple providers.
